insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-area online supermarket that builds its own tech, warehouses and electric vans; IND recognised sponsor with staff of 80+ nationalities.

culture.text: App-only supermarket that does almost everything itself, from forecasting and automated warehouses to electric vans and software.
Describes a scale-up culture with no strict structures, ownership from day one, and lots of social activities.
About 5,569 staff; many come from University of Amsterdam, TU Delft, HU Utrecht and VU Amsterdam.

open.text: Picnic Technologies B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 4 open jobs here don't ask for Dutch and half mention visa or relocation, but LinkedIn postings average about 200 applicants.
Says its team spans over 85 nationalities.

growth.text: Started in 2015 and now delivers groceries to millions across the Netherlands, Germany and France.
